key.description: Entry key, used verbatim as the output directory name. Must be a safe relative directory name (no slashes, no '..').

inputType.description: Where the requirement comes from: 'authored' (the user describes it -- free text and/or tag selections, which coexist) or 'adapted' (an existing work was uploaded). The retired values 'text', 'tags' and 'works' are still accepted and folded on read.

userInput.description: The requirement text for this entry. Coexists with tags -- both may be given.

tags.description: Raw tag selections: { selections, customTexts }. Coexists with userInput -- both may be given. Not used for routing, recorded for restore.
